group_assessment.weighting: Single private-hospital paediatric neurology clinic with an in-house genetics laboratory; retrospective 90-patient exome/genome/microarray series 2019-2021, about half referred from abroad. No WWOX-focused work.

field_density.note: No PubMed record indexes the protein change; the allele is reachable only through full text and tables.

multihop.note: 45 references enumerated; none is WWOX-direct. The WWOX content is the cohort's own case (Table 5 row and Supplementary Table S1 row), cited to ClinVar, not to a paper, so no hop is owed.

entries.proposition: The authors' classifications are dated: variants were classified as of June 2024.
entries.snippet: These genetic variants’ classification detected according to by June 2024.

entries.proposition: Variant classification rested on ACMG criteria, ClinVar, HPO matching and in-silico pathogenicity estimates; no functional assay of any variant is described.
entries.snippet: Filtering and prioritization of potentially disease-causing variants were performed based on the inheritance pattern, information in the ClinVar database, Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) terms associated with the patient's findings, and in silico pathogenicity estimates.

entries.proposition: Denominator: 90 children with unexplained epilepsy and/or developmental delay; exome alone gave P/LP variants in 20 of 58.
entries.snippet: Among the 58 patients who had undergone WES, P/LP variants were detected in 20 (34.4%)
